description: Replacing each propositional letter in the skeleton of an actual quantifier-free ground formula by its shared first-order atom returns that exact original formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton_roundtrip.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (A : L.Sentence)
  (hA : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.fromSkeleton
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A) =
    A
